notes: This is a Short Candidate thesis, and the numbers most responsible for that call verify cleanly and with unusual rigor: the current price, the EV bridge, the canonical net-debt and TTM-EBITDA computations (with their underlying raw inputs), the reconciled dual CIQ EV/EBITDA figures (97.7x vs 114.9x), the SBC unrecognized-expense pool ($105.82bn-$120.37bn, found verbatim in the 10-Q extract), Q2 2026 deliveries, consensus targets, and all scenario/expected-return/risk-reward/margin-of-safety math all tie out exactly or within normal rounding tolerance. Two medium-severity findings and two low-severity findings keep this from a clean 'Clean' verdict: (1) final_thesis's Kill Criteria table misattributes the 12.4% cost-of-capital figure (which is the valuation module's DCF WACC) to the business-model module (whose own WACC is 11.5%) -- a citation-attribution slip layered on an otherwise well-reconciled dual-WACC methodology; (2) the run's own finish-gate flagged, and this audit confirms, that final_thesis.md's Headline Scorecard 'Suggested sizing' text is not verbatim-identical to decision_record.json's sizing_hint.action string (same substance, different wording) -- the thesis was committed PROVISIONAL/UNVERIFIED with this warning still attached rather than resolved before commit; (3) a secondary short-interest figure (2.1%) is dated to 2026-07-23 in the thesis but the pool's actual 2026-07-23 value is 2.00% (2.1% belongs to the three prior trading days) -- low severity, does not feed the rating; (4) the warning banner's separate claim about scenario labels missing from an external 'sidecar' does not reconcile against decision_record.json as it actually exists in this run root (which contains all five scenarios matching the thesis table) -- likely a stale claim about an artifact (a Playground/UI sidecar) not present in analyses/TSLA_2026-07-25/ or data/TSLA/ and therefore not independently checkable by this audit. None of these findings are high or critical, none involve a fabricated or unsupported rating-driving number, and none break the core scenario math -- hence Minor issues rather than Material issues. The single most important finding is #2 above: a self-flagged PROVISIONAL/UNVERIFIED banner remains live at the top of a committed final_thesis.md, and the specific mismatch it names (sizing text) is real, though non-substantive.
